αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’

αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’

βελέων: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic βελῶν)
βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
βλεφάροισιν: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
βουλὴ: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. nom. sg.
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)

βὰν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)

γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γαίας)
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαίδαλα: δαίδαλον — intricate work, finely wrought thing; neut. acc. pl.
δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δεκάχιλοι: δεκάχιλοι — ten thousand (δέκα + χίλιοι); numeral adj., masc. nom. pl. (Attic μύριοι)
δεῦτ: δεῦτε — come here, hither; adv. used as a call to several, elided (δεῦτ’ = δεῦτε)
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
δηϊοτῆτος: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, combat (cf. δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. gen. sg., stem δηϊοτῆτ-
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
δολοφρονέουσα: δολοφρονέω — plot craftily, think guile; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονοῦσα)
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., + inf.: ’I am able’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of a noble woman · also fem. voc. sg., in address (δῖα θεάων): ’heavenly one among goddesses’
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; neut. acc. sg.

εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (εἰς Ἄϊδος ’to Hades’)
εἰσελθοῦσα: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’going in’
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may say’
εἶμ: εἶμι — go, shall go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense, elided (εἶμ’ = εἶμι)
εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
εἶχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contracted from ἔ-εχε): ’had, held (as wife)’ · also ’kept, maintained’ (ἀλαοσκοπιὴν εἶχε ’kept a careless watch’)
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — far-thundering, wide-sounding (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., epic short -α · also masc. nom. sg., epic short -α (εὐρύοπα Ζεύς ’far-thundering Zeus’)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μετάφρενον: ’broad’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’wide’
εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
θάλαμον: θάλαμος — inner chamber, bedroom; masc. acc. sg.
θήκατο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -κα- form, unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put on (for himself)’
θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, inner room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεάων: θεά — goddess; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θεῶν), partitive: ’of the goddesses’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess) · also masc. nom. sg. in a comparison: ’(like) a god’ (θεὸς ὣς)
θυγατρῶν: θυγάτηρ — daughter; fem. gen. pl., partitive after ἀρίστη: ’best of the daughters’
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’ · also with an aor. indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κέ τοι … φάνη ’there would have appeared to you’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κέ τίς … ἀτιμήσειε ’no one would dishonour’) · also εἴ κέ in an indirect question, + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj.: ’whether’ (εἴ κέ … ἀπώσεται ’whether he will thrust back’) · also εἰ … κέ + short-vowel subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ (εἰ … κέ σε … ἀπολύσομεν ’if we should release you’) · also εἰς ὅ κέ + long-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ … ἕληται ’until he takes’)
κέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass (+ dat.); plpf. 3 sg. with reduplication, impf. force: ’had excelled, excelled’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’
καλεοίμην: καλέω — call; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid./pass., uncontracted (= Attic καλοίμην): ’I would be called’
καλυδῶνι: Καλυδών — Calydon, a city of Aetolia; fem. dat. sg.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος: ’fair (plot)’
καλῷ: καλός — fair, beautiful; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀστέρι
καρδίῃ: καρδίη — heart; fem. dat. sg., Ionic (= Attic καρδίᾳ), of place: ’in the heart’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’)
κληῗδι: κληΐς — bolt, bar, key; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλείς, dat. κλειδί): ’with a key’
κλισιάων: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κλισιῶν)
κλυτὸς: κλυτός — famous, renowned; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also the masc. form used with a fem. name, nom. sg., agreeing with Ἱπποδάμεια
κλύον: κλύω — hear, hearken; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they heard’
κορυφῆς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. gen. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κρόνοιο: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
κυδιάνειραν: κυδιάνειρα — bringing glory to men (κῦδος + ἀνήρ); fem. acc. sg., epithet of ἀγορή ’assembly’ · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of μάχη ’battle’
κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, lap, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
κόσμον: κόσμος — order, due order, propriety; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
λίπ: λείπω — leave; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (λίπ’ = λίπε = ἔλιπε): ’left’ · also λίπα — richly, sleekly (adv.), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα), with ἀλείφομαι: ’richly (anointed)’
λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀδόντα: ’white’
λιπαροῖσιν: λιπαρός — sleek, glistening, glossy (as skin rubbed with oil); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
λύματα: λῦμα — filth, refuse washed off (in purification); neut. acc. pl.
λύσω: λύω — loose, release, set free; fut. 1 sg. (same form as aor. subj.)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. nom. pl., epithet of the gods
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.

μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐτάνυσσε: ’the fighting’ (μάχην ἐτάνυσσε ’stretched the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., cognate object of ἐμάχοντο: ’fight’ (μάχην ἐμάχοντο ’fought the fight’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ὄτρυνον: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., with ἐς following it: ’into the battle’ (μάχην ἐς κυδιάνειραν ’into the man-glorifying battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἤγειρας: ’the battle’ (μάχην ἤγειρας ’you stirred up the battle’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἔχουσι: ’the fight’ (μάχην … ἔχουσι ’keep up the fight’)
μάχονται: μάχομαι — fight; pres. 3 pl. mid., + dat.: ’fight against’
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέδοντες: μέδων — ruler, lord (part. of μέδω ’rule over’, used as noun); masc. voc. pl., address · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ἡγήτορες ἠδὲ μέδοντες ’leaders and rulers’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat.: ’among’ · also prep. + acc., ’after, in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕλην ’for wood’) · also prep. + acc., ’among, into the midst of’ (μεθ’ ὅμιλον ’among the throng’)
μερμήριξε: μερμηρίζω — ponder, devise, turn over in the mind; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμερμήριξε)
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after; + acc.: ’to, among’ (motion) · also + dat.: ’among’ (μετ’ ἀθανάτοισιν) · also + acc., ’next after’ (μετ’ ἀμύμονα Πηλεΐωνα) · also + acc., ’after, in pursuit of’ · also + gen.: ’among’ (μετ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’among the Achaeans’)
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μεῖνε: μένω — remain, stand firm; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμεινε): ’held his ground’
μητέρα: μήτηρ — mother; fem. acc. sg., in apposition to Ἴτωνα · also fem. acc. sg., pendent object resumed by a pronoun: ’as for my mother’ (μητέρα … τὴν … ἀπέλυσε) · also fem. acc. sg., after ὑπό of motion: ’under (his) mother’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
ναῖε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’lived’
νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
ξυνάγοντες: συνάγω (epic ξυν-) — bring together, join; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’joining, bringing together’
οἰνεὺς: Οἰνεύς — Oeneus, king of Calydon; masc. nom. sg.

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὐτάμενοί: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., athematic: ’wounded’; accented before the enclitic τε
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’

παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

πλευρῶνι: Πλευρών — Pleuron, a city of Aetolia; fem. dat. sg.
ποικίλον: ποικίλος — intricately wrought, many-coloured, dappled; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πέπλον · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’dappled, richly wrought’
ποιπνύοντα: ποιπνύω — bustle about, hurry busily; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’bustling’
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
πρέσβα: πρέσβα (poet. fem. of πρέσβυς) — eldest, first in rank; august, revered; fem. nom./voc. sg., in apposition to a goddess’s name
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.

πυκινὰς: πυκινός — thick, close-packed, dense; fem. acc. pl.

πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πύκα: πύκα — closely, thickly, carefully, firmly; adv.

σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’

τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with φθόγγον: ’your’

τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’

τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρίτατος: τρίτατος — third; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic τρίτος)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same form)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)

τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)

ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο)
ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ὀλοὸν: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὀλέθριον)
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀτρύνοντες: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅσσόν: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; neut. acc. sg., epic ὅσσον (= Attic ὅσον), adverbial before τε: ’as loud as’ · also ’as far as’ (ὅσσόν τ’ ἐπὶ οὖρα πέλονται ’as far as the furrow-lengths extend’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν · also ὅττι = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οὐδέ τι ᾔδη ὅττι … ’nor did he know that …’)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
